root.command: IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.GpsSettingsTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH('dbo.GpsSettingsTbl', 'UseRoadTimes') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.GpsSettingsTbl ADD UseRoadTimes BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_GpsSettings_UseRoadTimes DEFAULT (1); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.RoadLegTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.RoadLegTbl ( FromHash VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, ToHash VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, Seconds INT NOT NULL, Metres INT NOT NULL, FetchedAt DATETIME NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_RoadLeg_FetchedAt DEFAULT (GETDATE()), CONSTRAINT PK_RoadLegTbl PRIMARY KEY (FromHash, ToHash) ); END
